cacheMiss.title: Why the cache missed
cacheMiss.body: The first step to miss in the {{stage}} stage was {{step}}. {{cause}}

cause.base_changed: The base image changed, so every step after it rebuilt. Pin the base image digest to control when that happens.
cause.arg_changed: A build argument changed. Steps that read it cannot reuse the cache.
cause.source_changed: Files copied into the image changed. Copy only what an install needs first, then the rest after it.
cause.copy_before_install: An earlier COPY changed before the install ran. Copy the lockfile and manifest alone before the install step.
cause.earlier_step_changed: An earlier step changed, which invalidates every step after it.
cause.step_changed: The step itself or its inputs changed.
